note: 12 claims: 5 confirmed, 6 corrected, 1 unverified. Gong's own doc settles what our guide left open: refresh tokens exist, access tokens last 1 day by default, tokens come from /oauth2/generate-customer-token, and API calls go to the per-customer api_base_url_for_customer (not the fixed api.gong.io Composio tells users to enter).

rows.composio: Any user with Admin Centre access.
rows.ours: A Gong tech admin creates and authorizes it; plan not stated.
rows.provider: "Who can use this: Tech admin. Available on: Any Gong plan."

rows.claim: A Gong developer instance is needed first
rows.ours: Request a developer instance via Gong's form; it can take up to five working days.
rows.provider: "Step 1: Request a developer instance... This can take up to five working days."

rows.composio: Admin Centre → Ecosystem → API → Integrations tab → Create Integration.
rows.ours: Admin center → Settings → Ecosystem → API → Integrations → CREATE INTEGRATION.
rows.provider: "From the left sidebar, click Admin center. In the Settings tab, click API in the Ecosystem card. In the Integrations tab, click CREATE INTEGRATION."

rows.claim: Authorization context is permanent and personal access is limited
rows.ours: Shared vs Personal can't be edited later; Personal works only for api:ai-ask:read, api:ai-briefer:read and mcp scopes.
rows.provider: "this setting can't be edited once the integration is set up"; Personal access supported for api:ai-ask:read, api:ai-briefer:read, all mcp scopes.

rows.composio: Must match exactly, no trailing slash.
rows.ours: Not mentioned; listed as an open question.
rows.provider: redirect_uri "must match one of the redirect URIs you specified when registering your integration"; token-call redirect_uri must match the authorize one.

rows.claim: Scope needed for the GET /v2/users test call
rows.ours: api:users:read is a guess; endpoint came from a third-party snippet.
rows.provider: "When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:users:read'."

rows.claim: Token exchange endpoint and client auth
rows.ours: Not mentioned; guide only says to exchange the code.
rows.provider: POST https://app.gong.io/oauth2/generate-customer-token, form-encoded, with HTTP Basic Base64(client_id:client_secret).
Access token "by default is valid for 1 day" (validity_duration overrides); refresh via grant_type=refresh_token; auth code valid 10 minutes.

rows.claim: Per-customer API base URL returned with the token
rows.composio: Enter https://api.gong.io as the base URL for most tenants.
rows.ours: Token response includes api_base_url_for_customer (inferred from a third-party doc).
rows.provider: "The api_base_url_for_customer is different for each customer and should be saved as part of the customer's context."

rows.claim: Public availability goes through the Gong Collective
rows.ours: Publish to the Gong Collective before other organizations can install the app.
rows.provider: "Publish the app in the Gong Collective. Your customers can then install the app on their instance of Gong."

rows.ours: Gong reviews listings; no review time is published.
rows.provider: The Gong pages reached describe publishing but give no review steps, criteria or timeline.
"By default Gong limits your company's access to the service to 3 API calls per second, and 10,000 API calls per day."
